svg.title: The bus interface page after adding an APB slave, with numbered callouts: the list of interfaces on the core, seven of eight bus signals matched by name, the one signal PSELx that stays empty because the module calls it PSEL, and the Map by Name button.
svg.desc: The bus interface page after adding an APB slave, with numbered callouts: the list of interfaces on the core, seven of eight bus signals matched by name, the one signal PSELx that stays empty because the module calls it PSEL, and the Map by Name button.

g.text: One so far. It is called BIF_1 until you rename it, here to APB_TARGET.
PADDR, PENABLE, PWRITE, PRDATA, PWDATA, PREADY and PSLVERR found a port of the same name.
The standard says PSELx, the module has PSEL. Pick PSEL from the drop-down in this cell.
Repeats the name match, for example after you add a port to the Verilog and re-extract.
